experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Patients had I) normal glucose tolerance (NGT) and no liver disease, II) NGT and NAFLD, III) T2D without liver disease, IV) T2D with NAFLD, and V) cirrhosis.

number_of_fractions.evidence: After digestion, the peptides were separated by the Spider Fractionator (Kulak et al, 2017) into 24 fractions.

number_of_samples.evidence: Plasma proteome profiling on 48 patients with cirrhosis or NAFLD with normal glucose tolerance or diabetes, revealed 8 significantly changing (ALDOB, APOM, LGALS3BP, PIGR, VTN, IGHD, FCGBP and AFM), two of which are already linked to liver disease.

number_of_technical_replicates.evidence: After filtering for “reverse”, “only identified by site”, “contaminants”, and at least two valid values in any of the three technical replicates, we came to a dataset containing 684 protein groups (Dataset EV1, tab 2).
